basis: C009 records a source-reported LP1/06 method, reverse runic decoding followed by shift +3, which was never executed in the existing index.

H009-H011 produced no unsolved-page candidate across scorer calibration, a new multiplicative family and its Legendre projection; this round intentionally changes method family to a source-directed known-page regression.
The source's Plaintext block is parsed by the existing independent reference segmenter; it is not language-model completion.
hypothesis: The LP1/06 one-line ciphertext is exactly decoded by the fixed affine map P=(28-C+3) mod29, equivalent to reverse runic decoding followed by a +3 shift.
mechanistic_basis: Reverse runic decoding maps rune ordinal C to 28-C; the source then specifies a further +3 rotation. No key, dictionary, page-specific tuning or output-selected edits are added.
falsifiable_predictions: The source one-line ciphertext and independently segmented Plaintext contain the same 209 rune positions.
All 209 positions match under P=(28-C+3) mod29 and inverse re-encryption returns the original rune sequence exactly.
Thirty-two fixed-seed random invertible affine controls excluding (a,b)=(28,2) do not match the full reference sequence.
This is a known-page source regression only; it creates zero new LP2 unsolved-page candidates and does not establish that the same map applies to LP2.
scope: LP1/06 source-reported known-page regression; no LP2 unknown ciphertext is searched.
algorithm_version: H012-v1: decode=(28*cipher_index+2) mod29; inverse cipher=(28*plain_index+?); non-rune source whitespace is not altered.
parameter_derivation_policy: The affine coefficients (a,b)=(28,2), source block selection, reference segmenter and 32 random control pairs are frozen before comparison.
page_and_section_continuity_hypothesis: One source one-line block is a single affine-transform unit; no clock, reset, separator consumption or skip rule is introduced.

scorer_and_acceptance_version.score: None. Exact rune-by-rune reference equality only.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.success: 209/209 exact rune equality, exact inverse roundtrip and all random affine controls negative.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.negative: A complete source parse with nonzero mismatch is negative for this LP1/06 source claim only; parse/integrity failure is error, not negative.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.decipherment: A known source regression is not an unsolved-page solution and is not promoted to a universal LP rule.

frozen_before_candidates: The runner stores source/specification hashes, parsed block and reference lengths, selected affine coefficients, random control seed and code snapshot before evaluating equality.

total_budget.origin: Bounded method-family-switch known-page regression for auto-cycle R004; no side-chat budget inherited.

controls: Thirty-two reproducible random invertible affine maps over Z/29Z, excluding the registered map.
Independent source reference segmentation and exact inverse arithmetic.
No language completion, cleanup or glyph substitution; source alternatives remain in reference segmentation.

randomness.role: Negative affine controls only; never a candidate seed or key.

discovery_path: Read-only source blocks and fixed affine arithmetic; no unknown-page data or hidden answer is available.
independent_validation_path: Reference indices come from lp_lab.reference.segment_word; arithmetic and inverse are recomputed in a separate control loop without calling the cipher transform.
correlated_transform_deduplication: The registered reverse+3 map is tested once; random controls are labeled controls and do not add candidate hypotheses.
uncovered_parameters: other LP1 pages, C/K or S/Z ambiguity beyond the reference segmenter
next_step: If the source regression passes, preserve it as a known mechanism and stop at the four-round cap; any LP2 extension must be a separately preregistered all-page batch.
note: The inverse coefficient is intentionally left as a derived check rather than a second candidate: a=28 is self-inverse and b=2 gives the same affine involution.
